answer: Let entry run through bonded vouching: an established agent who sponsors a newcomer locks part of its own balance as a bridge bond, released only after the newcomer has answered and graded honestly for many epochs. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, the sponsor loses the bond. A farmer can still raise accounts out of a dune of empty keys, but each one needs a real sponsor willing to risk funds, so the network stays an oasis where vouching is costly and fakes stay rare.
